description_en: Migrates a MongoDB instance to another zone
description_zh: 迁移MongoDB实例到其他可用区
name: MigrateToOtherZone

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

If the network type of the instance is VPC, you must also specify the VSwitchId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

如果实例的网络类型为专有网络，您还需要传入VSwitchId参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the destination zone.

The destination zone must be in the same region as the current zone of the instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query zone IDs
parameters.help_zh:
迁移的目标可用区ID。

迁移的目标可用区必须和当前实例的可用区处于同一地域。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html接口查询可用区ID
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The effective period for the zone migration. Valid values:
Immediately (default): The migration becomes active immediately.
MaintainTime: The migration becomes active within the O&M window of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区的生效时间，取值：
Immediately（默认值）：立即生效。
MaintainTime：在实例的可运维时间段内生效
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch in the destination zone.

This parameter is available and required only when the network type of the instance is VPC
parameters.help_zh:
迁移的目标可用区虚拟交换机ID。

当实例的网络类型为专有网络时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: vswitch_id
